[[Brohn's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Brohn Stoneheart]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]]

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves casting time of [[Healing Prayers]] spells (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:[[Health]] +30
:Reduces [[Bleeding]] duration on you by 20%

== Replica ==
This staff cannot be replicated for several reasons:
* It effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Fear Cuts Deeper" and "Aptitude not Attitude."
* "Fear Cuts Deeper" is only available as an [[off-hand]] inscription. 
* It lacks the inherent 20% [[HSR]] that is present on all fully modifiable staves, except [[Envoy Staff]].

== Notes ==
*Other items with this appearance:
**{{any}} [[Droknar's Staff]]
**{{mo}} [[Kepkhet's Refuge]]
* Only three other staves have two inscriptions and are missing a HSR 20% mod: [[Gorrel's Staff]], [[Heleyne's Insight]] and [[Villnar's Staff]].
